declaration_site_pattern.retry_pivot: Two strikes then pivot: if the declaration-site pattern misses a known namespace twice, enumerate declaration sites per-registry by hand.
declaration_site_pattern.rule: A prefix is DECLARED only where a card/entry defines it (JSON identity key, markdown heading, table-first-cell, or definition). A prefix that only ever appears as a reference is DANGLING and is not a namespace.
